category_edits.rationale: Switch both bidirectional Transformer blocks to post-normalization across all four category models. Normalizing residual outputs may stabilize contextual representations. The predictor imports this same model class, preserving architecture and checkpoint consistency. Features, embeddings, readout, loss, optimizer and training schedule remain unchanged.

change_summary: Use post-normalization in every category’s BERT4Rec attention blocks, with matching inference through the existing predictor import.
